tutorials.title: Amazon Butler: outreach to brands you sell
tutorials.summary: Set up automated Creator Connections outreach for the brands behind your top-selling ASINs.

tutorials.title: Daily Commission Butler: accept campaigns from your sales
tutorials.summary: Auto-accept the right Amazon Creator Connections campaigns based on what you actually sold yesterday.

tutorials.title: CC Check: keep your Creator Connections catalog fresh
tutorials.summary: Run the SPCC + download-all jobs that keep your accepted-campaign catalog and SPCC offers up to date.

tutorials.title: Orders Butler: sync your real Amazon order history
tutorials.summary: Pull your purchase + commission history straight from Amazon so the rest of the app has accurate ASIN signal.

tutorials.title: Pricecrash Butler: catch Amazon pricing errors fast
tutorials.summary: Scan Amazon on a schedule for products discounted ≥99% off and hand the catches to Daily Deals Butler as drafts or auto-scheduled posts.

tutorials.title: Storefront Butler: sync every piece of your Amazon storefront
tutorials.summary: Pull photos, videos, idea lists, and media collections from your Amazon storefront into one searchable feed enriched with Creators API data.

tutorials.title: Data Refresh Butler: schedule when CC & SPCC catalogs refresh
tutorials.summary: One place to control how often the Creator Connections campaign catalog and SPCC commission catalog get re-downloaded.

tutorials.title: Daily Deals Butler: harvest Amazon deals and post them automatically
tutorials.summary: End-to-end automation: filter Amazon deals on price + discount + commission, build your post template, pick social destinations, and let the scheduler do the rest.

tutorials.title: Like Butler: auto-like Amazon Creator storefronts you want to stay visible to
tutorials.summary: Paste storefront links, set a like cap and delay, and Like Butler keeps you top-of-mind with brands by liking their CC storefront content on a cadence.

tutorials.title: Goldmine Butler: find brands already paying creators in your niche
tutorials.summary: Scan other creators' Amazon storefronts for #ad / #partner content to identify brands you should pitch.

tutorials.title: Video Butler: re-upload Amazon storefront videos with fresh metadata
tutorials.summary: Convert, re-encode, and re-upload your existing Amazon storefront videos with updated titles, descriptions, and tags.

tutorials.title: YouTube Butler: upload Amazon storefront videos to YouTube with affiliate links
tutorials.summary: Cross-post your shoppable Amazon videos to YouTube with affiliate links and automatic Shorts detection.

tutorials.title: Retag Butler: replace out-of-stock ASINs across your published content
tutorials.summary: Find every video, photo, and idea-list item pointing to an unavailable product and tag a replacement automatically.

tutorials.title: Relink Butler: swap affiliate link providers across published content (beta)
tutorials.summary: Rewrite affiliate links in your already-published Daily Deals, YouTube, Pinterest, and Benable content without re-editing each post.

tutorials.title: Voiceover Butler: FTC-compliant voiceover scripts from ASINs
tutorials.summary: Generate Amazon-Shoppable-compliant voiceover scripts for any ASIN, validated against Amazon's video rules and FTC disclosure requirements.

tutorials.title: Levanta Butler: automate outreach + email extraction across the Levanta brand network
tutorials.summary: Two-tab workspace that pitches Levanta-approved brands on autopilot and harvests brand contact emails during runs.

tutorials.title: Pitch Butler: one CRM for every brand pipeline you're working
tutorials.summary: Unified registry of brands you're prospecting, pitching, or negotiating with - imported from Creator Connections, Levanta, and Instagram extractor.

tutorials.title: Benable Butler: AI-built Amazon collections published to Benable (beta)
tutorials.summary: Type a niche keyword, pick a marketplace, and Benable Butler researches Amazon, picks matching ASINs, writes the collection, and publishes it.

tutorials.title: Benable Like Butler: auto-like other creators' Benable collections on a schedule
tutorials.summary: Paste Benable profile URLs, set max likes and delay, and Like Butler keeps you visible on those creators' recent-activity feeds.

tutorials.title: Benable Comment Butler: AI-written comments on Benable collections
tutorials.summary: Drop short, friendly, product-specific comments on Benable list items - AI-written from Amazon product details, canned fallback if the model fails.

tutorials.title: Collab Butler: Kanban tracker for every brand collaboration in flight
tutorials.summary: One board for every collab - pitched, in-production, posted, paid - with drag-to-update stages, filters, exports, and per-card payout + deadline detail.

tutorials.title: Instagram Butler: DM brand collaborations directly on Instagram
tutorials.summary: Send first-touch outreach DMs to brands and creators on Instagram using rotating templates, follower-count filters, and a do-not-message list.

tutorials.title: Messenger Butler: Instagram DMs to creators you discover
tutorials.summary: Send personalized opening DMs to the creators you've added to Instagram Butler's queue.

tutorials.title: Instagram Close Friends Butler: auto-add new followers to your Close Friends list
tutorials.summary: Automate adding new Instagram followers to your Close Friends list with strict per-hour and per-day rate limits and a do-not-add list.

tutorials.title: Instagram Email Collection: harvest brand emails hiding in your Instagram DMs
tutorials.summary: Scan your Instagram DMs for email addresses brands have shared in conversation, then export them to a reusable contact list.

tutorials.title: Instagram Goldmine: discover the brands paying creators in your niche on Instagram
tutorials.summary: Research-only crawler: seed with Instagram usernames, walk the suggested-accounts graph, and harvest posts tagged #ad / paid-partnership.

tutorials.title: API Integrations: store every API key Butler uses in one place
tutorials.summary: Central panel for connecting Amazon Creators API, Levanta, Archer, Logie, deeplink providers, OpenAI, YouTube, and more.

tutorials.title: Action Queue: one inbox for every butler that needs your decision
tutorials.summary: When any workspace hits a fork - approve a message, pick between options, accept a campaign - the decision lands here instead of blocking the run.

tutorials.title: Content Butler: drag-and-drop calendar for what to film next
tutorials.summary: Schedule the products you want to shoot on a Monthly / Weekly / Daily calendar. Drag from Orders Butler or add manually, tag by content type.

tutorials.title: Black Friday Butler: never miss a time-limited Amazon deal on your storefront
tutorials.summary: Monitor your Amazon storefront on a cadence and log every Black-Friday-flagged or time-limited deal with timestamps.

tutorials.title: Ads Goldmine: surface high-value ASINs by ad + sponsor density signals
tutorials.summary: Score the ASINs in your catalog across four signal tiers - Lightning Deals, Creator Connections, SPCC offers, brand-search density.

tutorials.title: Pinterest Butler: Pinterest pin generation + scheduling (coming soon)
tutorials.summary: Planned workspace that will generate pins from Amazon Idea Lists, prioritize by active CC campaigns, write SEO copy, and schedule posts.
